verdict.rationale: Highnote's agentic-commerce docs explicitly describe issuing per-agent, per-workflow virtual cards via API that auto-close when the workflow ends, combined with velocity limits, MCC restrictions, and per-transaction caps enforced at authorization — a direct implementation of scoped, least-privilege credentials for AI agents, backed by unified ledger visibility for auditing agent spend. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scoping/permissions for the underlying platform API keys/tokens themselves (as opposed to the issued financial card credentials), and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
